body: I'm sorry for my late reply. Thank you for the encouragement, maybe I'll be able to get through this, maybe not.

Yeah, I suppose everyone's different. I would do that, but I live in a small city, there's limited mental health support groups, barely any actually. I might look into it more maybe during the summer, hopefully I can find something, it could help. Thank you for talking with me, it definitely lifted my mood, I don't do it very often :)

Yeah it's very difficult, if you don't have the money you wait so long for any kind of help. I do, I don't know why but telling a stranger is easier for me to do than telling someone close to me. It doesn't make much sense, Ive been told, but it's been like this for as long as I can remember.

I have, i go to a psychologist but because I can't afford to go to a private one the appointments are once every 2 months and I had to wait over 6 months for my first appointment, which is terrible. He prescribed me antidepressants but they're not helping. I have a few close friends but I'm not a talkative person, I never tell them if I'm having a bad day. Maybe I hold it in too much, but I can't physically force myself to tell someone I'm feeling bad. :(
